schema_version.description: 1 = original; 2 adds logo/repo/bundled; 3 adds review plus signature/publisher_key_id (all additive, v1/v2 entries stay valid).

updated.description: Date of the last index change (YYYY-MM-DD).

allOf.description: Registry-installable entries need a source; bundled catalog listings do not.

slug.description: Kebab-case, must match the manifest's name.

bundled.description: true for builtin extensions shipped inside the panel. Catalog listings only (not installed from the registry), so source/sha256 are optional. Generated from the panel repo via scripts/export-registry-entries.mjs.

source.description: Repo URL (latest release), release-tag URL, or direct .zip URL. Optional for bundled entries.

sha256.description: sha256 of the exact zip `source` resolves to. Enforced when present.

signature.description: Schema v3: base64 ed25519 detached signature over the exact zip `source` resolves to. Verified against the pinned publisher key named by `publisher_key_id`. Absent => the panel treats the entry as unsigned; for first_party entries that costs an explicit install-consent prompt (see the panel's signing_service.verify_for_install).

publisher_key_id.description: Schema v3: id of the publisher key that must verify `signature` (e.g. 'serverkit-official'). Must name a key the panel pins in app/data/extension_signing_keys.json, or one the operator added via SERVERKIT_TRUSTED_EXTENSION_KEYS; an unpinned id downgrades to a consent prompt rather than silently passing.

featured.description: Surface this entry in the Marketplace's featured rail.

feature_score.description: Ranking weight within the featured rail (higher sorts first). Absent is treated as 0 by the panel.

review.description: Review stamp (schema v3): asserts that `reviewer` inspected the exact artifact whose sha256 is recorded here. Bound to the artifact: review.sha256 MUST equal the entry's sha256, so any change to the released zip invalidates the stamp (validators error on mismatch). Absence means unreviewed.

reviewer.description: GitHub handle of the person who reviewed the artifact.

sha256.description: sha256 of the reviewed zip. Must match the entry's sha256.

commit.description: Optional git commit the reviewed artifact was built from.

repo.description: https URL of the extension's source repository.

logo.description: Extension logo. Either an https:// URL or a repo-relative path 'assets/<slug>/<file>'. Repo-relative paths are rewritten to absolute URLs by the serverkit.ai /ext endpoint.

icon.description: Inner SVG markup (24x24 viewBox assumed by the panel).
